dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

You'll likely continue to make payments as usual, and the new institution will handle your account. I can't provide specific details about the new institution or any changes to your servicing, but rest assured that your loan terms remain the same. If you have concerns about the new institution, you can review your loan documents or wait for correspondence from them.
